name: What should I bring to an All-Levels Vinyasa Yoga class?
description: Bring a yoga mat, comfortable athletic wear, and water. Cave Training provides mats, but bringing your own can offer a more consistent experience.

mainEntity.name: What should I bring to an All-Levels Vinyasa Yoga class?

acceptedAnswer.text: For an All-Levels Vinyasa Yoga class, you should bring a yoga mat, comfortable athletic wear, and a water bottle to stay hydrated. Many practitioners also find a small towel useful. If you don't have a mat, Cave Training provides mats for use during class. Bringing your own mat, however, can provide a more consistent and personalized experience.
